items.why: Volatility is up nearly 5% as the tech sell-off deepens, hedge funds post their worst daily drawdown since Covid, and the market splits into two camps.
Oil is up again ahead of Friday's flash October inflation data, named as one of the key items shaping the market.
AMD is up as tech steadies to end a rocky week, with the Nasdaq rising after the sharp sell-off even as the Dow and S&P 500 fall.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Afternoon tape: ES=F -0.52%, NQ=F flat at +0.04%, YM=F -1.18% as tech steadies into the close of a rocky week.
summary: Friday is a split market: the Dow and S&P 500 are dropping, the Nasdaq is up after the tech sell-off, and oil is climbing again ahead of the flash inflation print.
